title: Motion for an extension of time within which to file the briefs on the merits in No. 24-556 (also as to No. 24-820 & 24-860)

pages.text:
U.S. Department of Justice
       Office of the Solicitor General




       Washington, D.C. 20530

       June 20, 2025

Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543

  Re:  Joe Fernandez v. United States, No. 24-556
 Daniel Rutherford v. United States, No. 24-820
 Johnnie Markel Carter v. United States, No. 24-860

Dear Mr. Harris:

 All three of the above-captioned cases concern the interpretation of the phrase “extraordinary and compelling reasons” in 18 U.S.C. 3582(c)(1)(A)(i).  Because of the press of other matters,
and with the understanding that the cases may be calendared for oral argument in the Court’s
November sitting, the parties in each of the se cases respectfully request the following extensions
of time within which to file their principal merits briefs.

In No. 24-556, the petition for a writ of certiorari was granted on May 27, 2025, and petitioner’s opening brief is currently due on J uly 11, 2025.  The parties in No. 24-556 respectfully
request, under this Court’s Rule 30.4, that the time within which to file petitioner ’s brief (and the
joint appendix) be extended to and including August 4, 2025, and that the time within which to
file respondent’s brief be extended to and including September 25, 2025.  The parties in No. 24 -
556 consent to this briefing schedule.

In Nos. 24-820 and 24-860, which have been consolidated, the petitions for writs of certiorari were granted on June 6, 2025, and petitioners’ opening briefs are currently due on July 21,
2025.  The parties in Nos. 24-820 and 24-860 respectfully request, under this Court’s Rule 30.4,
that the time within which to file petitioner’s brief (and the joint appendix) in each of the two
consolidated cases be extended to and including August 8, 2025, and that the time within which to
file respondent’s brief in each of the two consolidated cases be extended to and including September 25, 2025.  All parties in Nos. 24-820 and 24-860 consent to this briefing schedule.

      Sincerely,



      D. John Sauer
      Solicitor General
